# Feature Integration Skill

Guides and automates the process of integrating new features into the project. Handles planning, code updates, tests, docs, and reviews.

## Example Prompts
- "Integrate a new deck builder feature."
- "Add asset manager improvements."
- "Update plugin showcase logic."
